items.name: Machine age
items.description: Archival B&W cut of steam trains, presses and steel pours on a 120 BPM drop. It has a horizontal motion-blurred whip, two speed ramps, two flash frames and a "BUILT TO MOVE" title.

items.name: Liftoff
items.description: Rockets and orbit footage in a warm navy-to-cream tint on 110 BPM background music. A night-pad cold open rides the riser, then an upward whip and a "LAUNCH DAY" title.

items.name: Make waves (9:16)
items.description: Vertical social reel of vintage speedboats in a teal duotone. It starts one beat before the 105 BPM track re-enters after its break, reframes each shot for portrait, and ends on a stacked "MAKE WAVES" title.
